tools.name: query_graph
tools.description: Search group node metadata and stored cross-source relation signals/evidence by all query terms. Use requirement IDs, API paths or relation names to find matching relations, both endpoints and graph neighbors; pin group_version on follow-up calls.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get a source-qualified graph node ID or exact label. Ambiguous labels return candidates; use their IDs.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.

tools.name: find_path
tools.description: Find a shortest undirected trace through actual graph edges, at most eight hops. Returned links preserve their real direction and evidence kind.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.description: Read actual incoming/outgoing graph edges and adjacent nodes. Preserves parallel edges and provenance.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.

tools.name: get_relation
tools.description: Read a graph edge and its cross-source relation evidence. Quotes are checked against the exact pinned source text.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Read exact UTF-8 text from the group's immutable source snapshot, with provenance and checksums. Maximum 2 MiB per file and 400 lines per call; preserves full lines.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search pinned source texts for a case-sensitive literal (no regular expressions). Optional glob supports * and ?. Returns exact lines and provenance; bounded scans report partial results.

group_version.description: Pin a prior response's group_version; mismatch is rejected.
